title: Golem compiler diagnostic
description: Review finding 15: one structured compiler diagnostic, written as one JSON object per line by golem build --format json (CONTRACTS.md 'CLI'). Codes are stable and namespaced by the §13.1 check number (proposed decision PD-33).

Diagnostic.description: §13.1, finding 15 diagnostic: code, severity, message, primary span, violated § reference and optional related spans.

DiagnosticCode.description: PD-33 stable code C<nn>/<slug>: nn is the §13.1 check number 01-14, or 00 for lexical and syntax errors of §3-§4; slug is kebab-case and never reused for a different meaning once frozen.

Severity.description: §13.1: every check is an error; the three warnings are catch arms for failures that cannot occur (C08), unused imports (C01) and requires clauses implied by a callee's own requires (C07).

SpecRef.description: The violated section, written § followed by its number, e.g. §9.5.

SourcePosition.description: PD-16: line and column are 1-based, the column counted in Unicode code points; offset is the 0-based UTF-8 byte offset into the file (§3: source is UTF-8).

SourceSpan.description: §3, finding 15 Half-open source range [start, end) in one file; file is the project-relative path (src/...), or std/golem/<module>.golem for the standard library.

RelatedSpan.description: §13.1, finding 15 A secondary location, such as the other end of a cycle or the clashing declaration.
